description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); One(ID LONG primary key) with one row. Table U as in like-ranges (the same units, ID 39 Null); then V(ID LONG primary key, c TEXT(1)) with [i I İ ı k K s ſ ǅ ǆ Ǆ Ω ω µ Μ] as IDs 1 to 15. For each pattern [[h-j] ;; [j-l] ;; [r-t] ;; [ǆ] ;; [ω] ;; [μ] ;; i ;; k ;; s ;; ω]: SELECT ID FROM V WHERE c LIKE pattern. For each condition [WHERE (c + '') LIKE '*' ;; WHERE NOT ((c + '') LIKE '*') ;; WHERE c LIKE '**' ;; WHERE NOT (c LIKE '**') ;; WHERE c LIKE '*' & '' ;; WHERE NOT (c LIKE '*' & '') ;; WHERE c LIKE '?*' ;; WHERE NOT (c LIKE '?*') ;; WHERE NOT (c LIKE 'a*') ;; WHERE c NOT LIKE '*a']: SELECT ID FROM U condition. Then SELECT Null LIKE '*', NOT (Null LIKE '*'), IIf(c LIKE '*', 1, 0), IIf(NOT (c LIKE '*'), 1, 0) FROM U WHERE ID = 39 (one expression a SELECT). like-ranges found class ranges compared by lowercased code units and NOT (c LIKE '*') keeping the Null row: asks which lowercase mapping, and whether the Null rule is a rewrite of a column predicate.
